_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin' to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.dst: Mira, tengo unas cosillas aquí... míralas, son todas rarísimas...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.dst: Veo ese brillo en tus ojos... ¿Te interesa algo de aquí? Todo está en venta...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.dst: ...Oye, humanito... No quiero asustarte, pero ¿sabes quién es ese tipo que se te acerca por detrás?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.dst: Te encontramos fuera de {p}, desmayado junto a un cadáver, y... ¡bueno, por la muerte de ese mercader había que detener a alguien!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.src: So, welcome to the {p} Federal Prison. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.dst: Así que bienvenido a la Prisión Federal de {p}. Te quedas aquí de por vida, narizcorta, así que no te quejes.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.dst: Y no creas que vas a pasarte el día tumbado en la celda. Aquí se trabaja, o acabas en el agujero.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.dst: Pero por ahora te quedas en tu celda, ¿entendido? Venga, quédate aquí y echa un vistazo a la celda. Ya sabrás cuándo toca trabajar...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.dst: Ay, gracias al grook, solo eres otro preso... Y tan joven...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.dst: Acabas de llegar, ¿verdad? Bueno... se nota que eres inocente... Como casi todos en esta prisión maldita...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.dst: Escucha, humano... Esta prisión... ¡No hay otra más espantosa en todo el mundo! ¡¡Esto es un infierno!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.dst: ¡Los guardias de aquí son unos sádicos! ¡Sacan presos al azar de sus celdas y nadie los vuelve a ver! ¡Quieren matarnos a todos aquí dentro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.dst: ¡Hablo en serio, humano! ¡Si te quedas, a ti también te matarán! TIENES que escapar de aquí, cueste lo que c-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Eh, basura! Te vienes con nosotros. ¡Fuera de la celda, YA!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.dst: ¿Está seguro, eh, señor? Creo que hoy no me toca ir a ningún sitio...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.dst: Ah, ¿te crees listo resistiéndote?? ¡Eh, Jon, bloquea la entrada!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.dst: ¡EH! ¡Deja de mirar al vacío, gusano! Ven a los barrotes de tu celda.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.dst: Hora de trabajar, basura. Te escolto a los pasillos. Allí alguien te dirá qué hacer. Obedece y puede que esta noche vuelvas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.dst: ¿Te queda claro, desgraciado? ¡Venga, fuera de la celda!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.dst: Así que a ti te toca limpiar, ¿eh? Bien. ¡Escucha, escoria!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.dst: Coge esta esponja y recorre los pasillos. Si ves suciedad, límpiala con la esponja. Cuando acabes, alguien te escoltará de vuelta a las celdas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.dst: Busca suciedad que limpiar por los pasillos

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.dst: ¿Ya has terminado de limpiar? Bien, toca pasar lista. Te escoltamos de vuelta al bloque de celdas. Sígueme y no te muevas.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya... ¡Parece que la escoria de la sociedad llega puntual!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.dst: Bien. ¡En fila y quietos, gusanos! Hora de pasar lista...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.dst: Estáis todos… ¡Ja! Qué sorpresa, ¡los marginados sabéis obedecer!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.dst: ...Mmm… Parece que también tenemos un recién llegado... Tranquilo, siervo... tu alma estará bien guardada aquí por toda la eternidad.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.dst: Bien. Por ahora es todo, inútiles. Hora de comer. Id al comedor y rezad para que no sea vuestra última comida.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.dst: Busca un sitio donde sentarte en el comedor

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.dst: Me estoy... muriendo de hambre... esos malditos guardias no... me dejan coger comida...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.dst: Por favor... a mi derecha... hay comida ahí puesta; si me la trajeras, te estaría... eternamente agradecido...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.dst: No... no sé cómo agradecértelo, humano... Con esto podré aguantar...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.dst: Oye... si algún día sales de este matadero... ¿podrías ir a {p}... y hablar con mi familia? ¿Decirles que sigo vivo...? Te lo agradecería....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.dst: Eh... Tranquilo, puedes sentarte aquí, no pasa nada.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.dst: Así que... eres nuevo, ¿no? Je… Supongo que eres inocente, como el resto de nosotros… y lo digo en serio...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.dst: Dice la verdad, novato. Casi todos aquí somos civiles corrientes. Yo trabajaba en una empresa de transportes de {p} y llevaba unas cajas a {p} cuando me trincaron nada más salir de la ciudad.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.dst: ¡Yo igual! ¡Ni siquiera sé por qué me metieron aquí! ¡No hubo juicio ni nada! ¡Me sacaron de la calle y me tiraron aquí dentro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.dst: Porque quieren matarte, por eso. ¿Te has enterado de lo de Revan? Se lo llevaron hace un par de días por tropezar sin querer al pasar lista. Nadie ha vuelto a saber de él.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.dst: Yo… seguramente tengas razón... Ya no entiendo nada de esto... Solo quiero largarme de este maldito sitio para siempre...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.dst: ...Suerte con eso... La única salida es esa puerta, y aun así antes tienes que entrar en la sala de control. Es... simplemente imposible, ¿sabes?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.dst: ¡Venga, se acabó la comida! ¡A vuestras celdas, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.dst: ...Bueno… Así es este sitio en pocas palabras, humano. Procura no estorbar a nadie ni salirte de la fila y estarás bien hasta que acaben llevándote a ti.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.dst: Eh, ¿y este quién es? No te conocemos. ¡Circula!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.dst: Eh, eh, déjalo estar, Don. No le hace daño a nadie.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.dst: No le des importancia. Y bien... ¿Sabes quiénes somos, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.dst: Somos de la Placido Crime Family. Hacemos negocios por todo el mundo; en todos los rincones, ¿me entiendes?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.dst: Casi todos los de esta mesa caímos por andar con la familia-... Ah, te sorprende oír que en este matadero hay alguno culpable de verdad, ¿eh?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.dst: Tranquilo, no temas que a nosotros nos saquen y nos maten como a los demás piacevole de aquí. Los guardias repiten algo de que "nuestras almas están demasiado manchadas", vete a saber.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.dst: ¡Ja! Puede que a ti te traten igual, novello. Lo vi en cuanto te eché la vista encima. Tú también matas, ¿a que sí? Eh, hay que serlo para reconocer a otro...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.dst: ...En fin... ¿Piensas quedarte en esta prisión, fratello? Un consejo: no. Si puedes, tienes que escapar. Quizá creas que es imposible salir de aquí, o lo que sea...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.dst: ¡Venga, se acabó la comida! ¡A vuestras celdas, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.dst: Pero no, tú eres distinto. Lo veo en esos ojos. Solo tienes que encontrar cómo entrar en esa sala de control. Y oye, si sales de aquí, ve a montar el follón en el Mercado Negro de Letvus por nosotros, ¿vale?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#065.dst: Acude al pase de lista de la mañana

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.dst: ¡Venga! ¡Todos en pie! ¡Fuera de las celdas, YA! ¡Hora de pasar lista!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.dst: ¡Venga, la vista al frente, escoria! El pase de lista va a empezar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.dst: ...¿estáis todos...? Mmm... Decepcionante, la verdad. Se acabó la lista. ¡Todos a vuestro puesto de trabajo, y a currar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.dst: Busca posibles rutas de huida por los pasillos y consigue un uniforme de guardia

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.dst: Preséntate ante el guardia de la prisión en [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.dst: ¿Ya has acabado? Bien, sígueme. El pase de lista va a empezar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.dst: ¿Pero qué os pasa, llegando tarde así?? ¡Hora de pasar lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.dst: Estáis todos, ¿eh? Muy bien, pues id a ce-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.dst: ¡Eh! ¿De qué demonios hablas, inventándote algo así? ¡Yo no he hecho nada!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.dst: ¡Cállate, narizgorda! ¡Sabes muy bien lo que hacías! ¡Y ahora apártate!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.dst: ¡EH! ¿¡Estáis ciegos o qué!? ¡Guardias, controlad a esos indeseables!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.dst: ¡Vaya morro tenéis los dos, peleando mientras se pasa lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.dst: Sois idiotas de verdad, ¿eh? ¿Pelearos rodeados de guardias? Y encima con un pincho...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.dst: Bueno, se acabó la partida para vosotros dos, marginados. ¡Directos al agujero!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: Tú, lleva a estos dos cretinos al agujero; y tú, ve a mi despacho y coge una llave de repuesto de la sala de control. Y ahora, ¡LUCES FUERA!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.dst: Acude al pase de lista de la mañana

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.dst: ¡Venga! ¡Todos en pie! ¡Fuera de las celdas, YA! ¡Hora de pasar lista!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: ¡Venga, todos en fila y bien rectos! ¡No os mováis, o se acabó para vosotros!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: Vaya, vaya, vaya... Otro siervo que se cree listo saliéndose de la fila...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.dst: ¡E-espere un momento, señora! ¡Alguien me empujó fuera de la fila! ¡Se lo juro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.dst: ¡SILENCIO! ¡No te he dado permiso para hablar, basura!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: ¡Vuelve a la fila! ¡Cuando esto acabe, estás acabado, sabandija!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over for you all!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.dst: ¡Venga, los demás, a trabajar! ¡Para vosotros se acabó la lista!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: Roba la llave del despacho de la alcaidesa y ve a la sala de control

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.dst: Encuentra la forma de abrir la puerta de salida

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.dst: Cruza la puerta de salida en [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.dst: Esquiva a los guardias y encuentra el camino a la sala de archivos

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: ¡Ay, gracias a la santa vaca! Por fin una cara amiga por aquí...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.dst: ¡Escucha, humano, tienes que sacarme de aquí! ¡Llevan todo el día matando gente ahí dentro! ¡Si no me ayudas, el siguiente soy yo!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: ¡Mira, al lado de mi celda, en esa mesa! ¡Hay una llave! ¡Cógela y dámela!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: No sé cómo explicarte lo que te debo, humano... No te imaginas lo agradecido que estoy...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: Oye, ¿cómo te llamas, humano? ¿{u}? Bien, yo soy Kaetan. Tú sal de aquí, que yo te alcanzo. Si logras salir de este desguace, búscame en {p}, quiero darte algo allí.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: ¿Eh...? ¡Oh- EH! ¡La mesa se ha prendido, que venga alguien a ayudarme a apagarla!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: Encuentra y destruye tu expediente criminal

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: ¿¿QUÉ?? Taron, ¿¿e-está vivo?? Y tú... ¿evitaste que muriera de hambre en esa prisión...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: Yo... humano, no sé cómo agradecértelo. Aunque no salga de ahí, solo saber que vive ya es... por favor, sé que no es mucho, pero toma esto.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: ¿M-mi hijo? ¡¿Vivo?! Ay, por la sagrada vaquilla... ¿¿Dónde está??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: ...en la prisión, ¿eh? Bueno... Me alegra saber que podrá aguantar un poco más... Muchísimas gracias, humano. ¡Toma, quédate esto!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.dst: La única forma de escapar es cruzar la puerta de salida. Para abrirla tendrás que acceder a la sala de control...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: Parece que la prisión miente al gobierno sobre casi todo lo que hace, y el gobierno se lo traga, pese a todos los rumores sobre este lugar.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.dst: Parece que la única forma de salir de aquí es esa puerta...
